result.description: A fictional compact USB television tuner designed for receiving over-the-air UHF broadcasts on desktop and laptop systems. The Nebula Quill features DVB-T2 reception, a detachable antenna, and simple channel-scan software for lightweight media setups. It is intended for users who want a basic broadcast receiver rather than storage or graphics hardware.
